title: Side Path — Factions and Salvage
purpose: Pursue settlements, criminal networks, recovered infrastructure, and a risky alternate route into industrial capacity.

milestones.title: Rumors of the Industrial Underworld
milestones.capability: Discover a settlement rumor, map fragment, radio message, or NPC lead pointing toward organized industrial crime.
final_validation: Obtain a credible lead from exploration, trade, radio traffic, or a faction encounter.

milestones.title: Break the Criminal Industrial Network
milestones.capability: Defeat, negotiate with, expose, or dismantle the criminal NPC leadership controlling an abandoned industrial site.
final_validation: Resolve the criminal leadership through combat, negotiation, evidence, or faction support.

milestones.title: Discover an Abandoned Factory
milestones.capability: Locate and secure a procedurally placed or authored abandoned factory instead of constructing every industrial line yourself.
final_validation: Secure the site, survey intact machines, and verify that the factory is not an unlimited free-resource cache.

milestones.title: Restore the Abandoned Factory
milestones.capability: Repair power, safety, inputs, and at least one intact production line to gain heavy industrial capacity through salvage.
final_validation: Restore safe power and operate one useful production line.
Repair missing logistics and supply inputs rather than receiving free perpetual output.
Accept that the recovered layout may be inefficient and require later improvement.

milestones.title: Recover the Factory Control System
milestones.capability: Audit, repair, and safely operate the abandoned factory's programmable controller and production queue.
final_validation: Bring the recovered controller online.
Inspect its program rather than trusting unknown automation blindly.
Queue and complete one controlled production order.

milestones.title: Join an Industrial Faction
milestones.capability: Earn membership through a playstyle that matches one faction's values rather than paying a universal entrance fee.
final_validation: Use the pause-menu directory to understand reputation and eligibility.
Build reputation through trade, defense, industry, research, or predatory behavior.
Sneak-right-click a faction member after becoming eligible to join.

milestones.title: Trusted Faction Companion
milestones.capability: Recruit a trusted faction member who follows and defends you without converting every neutral NPC into a disposable follower.
final_validation: Reach 60 reputation with your joined faction.
Hold at least 8 IC Credits and sneak-right-click a faction member.
Verify that the companion follows, defends, persists through saving, and can be dismissed with another sneak-right-click.

milestones.title: Raise a Covered Car Workshop
milestones.capability: Deploy the one-block Car Workshop controller as a complete 9×7 industrial set piece and protect its machinery from rain.
final_validation: Place the Car Workshop to deploy its assembly bay.
Add a roof that prevents rain from reaching the controller.
Connect IC2 EU at the displayed voltage tier.

milestones.title: Motorize the Frontier
milestones.capability: Manufacture one purpose-built road vehicle: compact car, off-roader, passenger carrier, tractor, utility cart, or scout ATV.
final_validation: Select and complete one vehicle program in the Car Workshop.
Deploy the resulting vehicle crate and verify driving, fueling, and braking.

milestones.title: Industrial Service Carrier
milestones.capability: Build the top-tier mobile support vehicle with onboard crafting, 54 cargo slots, a 64,000 mB tank, and a parked BuildCraft pipe interface.
final_validation: Manufacture the Passenger Carrier program and deploy its minibus chassis.
Open its cargo hold and mobile crafting grid while parked.
Park beside a Vehicle Service Dock and transfer both an item and a fluid through connected pipes.

milestones.title: Connect the Nation Exchange
milestones.capability: Witness two loaded city cargo controllers exchange a locally specialized product over the shared nation channel.
final_validation: Locate two operational cities with powered utility spines.
Keep both regions loaded and observe a specialty item reach the paired controller.
Compare settlement prices and confirm reputation only modestly changes the exchange.

milestones.title: Commission an Advanced Armament Factory
milestones.capability: Deploy a covered Gun Factory and use its IC2-powered production program for a shotgun or automatic rifle instead of hand crafting advanced firearms.
final_validation: Place and roof the Gun Factory set piece.
Complete either the Combat Shotgun or Automatic Rifle factory program.
If rain rusts the controller, repair it at a Repair Bench using one IC2 Machine Block.
